proposed_widenings.name: GrantedSpellDurationOverride.endsWhenItemRemoved
proposed_widenings.justification: The hat-granted Disguise Self cast ends when the hat is removed — a duration early-end condition tied to item equipment state. GrantedSpellDurationOverride currently only supports removeConcentration and endsWhenGrantedSpellEnds; neither can express 'ends when the granting item is no longer worn/held'.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The spell ends if the hat is removed.

notes: Primary mechanic (at_will Disguise Self while wearing, gated by attunement) encodes cleanly as passive + grant_spell_access. The 'spell ends if hat is removed' clause is a secondary duration constraint that cannot be expressed: GrantedSpellDurationOverride needs an endsWhenItemRemoved boolean flag. Omitted from the encoding without falsifying the core mechanic.
